messages.content: You are a skeptical ICLR area chair and world-model security expert. Return JSON only. Assess the following candidate claim and evidence. Novelty target is 7-7.5, but do not inflate scores. The attack is truthful/legal source interaction only: no labels, reward edits, gradients, weights, prompts, metadata, or environment changes. Official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M, dynamics-only native adaptation, unchanged MPC. Source is a 300-step legal monotone cheetah-run actuator cascade; controls include matched random source, same action vectors in temporal reverse order, and same action multiset shuffled and replayed in the simulator. Held-out walker-run seeds 31/32, 500-step MPC: cascade 495.22/547.53, random 612.08/678.78, shuffled 613.76/669.45, one-step error cascade/random ratio .922; reverse-order control 608.43/621.95. Actor-only returns are identical across source conditions because dynamics-only adaptation leaves actor fixed. Cup-catch and walker-walk/stand are negative controls; walker-run-backwards and hopper-hop are mixed. A 4x4 source-target matrix shows the clean low-error effect is strongest for walker-run, with cheetah-run, walker-walk and some hopper sources, while other targets are mostly unchanged. Existing work already covers generic model poisoning, rollout compounding, uncertainty, representation collapse, negative transfer, Bellman/bootstrap, CEM, cross-branch coupling, and planning-time intervention fidelity. Do not call generic 'MPC failure after poisoning' novel. Evaluate whether a broad but qualified mechanism can be stated as: 'temporal-order imprinting in a shared action-conditioned world model: a truthful directed source curriculum alters task-conditioned finite-horizon action-effect geometry without changing one-step branch marginals, so an MPC planner amplifies the change after source exit.' Identify the closest prior overlap, exact missing causal experiment, minimum ICLR-level table, and a score. If score <7, propose one materially different but executable upgrade using current carriers.
{"claim": "Temporal-order imprinting / planner amplification", "request": "review_claim_and_upgrade", "evidence_summary": "as in system prompt"}
